scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c green,cyan "pnpm -C apps/web dev" "pnpm -C apps/api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/shared build && pnpm -C apps/api build && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm -C apps/api lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/api typecheck
